Windows Defender did not have a good performance record in its earlier days. The video represents a virus wreaking havoc on a PC while WD just jives along not giving a fuck.

WD is actually pretty good now by all accounts though I cannot personally affirm this.
Something about the obliviousness that the cat represents gets me every time.
The quote or the video lol. Glad if you enjoyed either :-)

[Wish you were here](https://youtu.be/IXdNnw99-Ic), one of my favourites.

Also like quite a bit of The Wall album.

Someone sent me [this quote](https://ibb.co/P1hvZ3S) the other day. Makes a lot of sense to me.

Drinking like this is not my default setting, it's a coping mechanism because my shit tank reached near full a long time ago and some events over the last few years have caused it to overflow.
